verdict.rationale: Ramp has its own travel booking product with per diem and policy status (ramp-docs-18, ramp-docs-19) and captures card receipts automatically (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32). Its CLI exposes a `transactions trips` subcommand and the MCP server publishes trips:read and trips:write scopes, which hints that transactions are associated with trips. No evidence shows bookings, card spend, and receipts automatically rolling up into a single itinerary-linked report, so only the building blocks and implied trip linkage are documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic trip-level grouping of bookings, card transactions, and receipts; an itinerary-linked report view for employees; hands-on or independent corroboration.
